threads.body: [General] `camel.context` is emitted on every Camel metric (`library/src/main/resources/jmx/rules/camel.yaml`:9, 113, 206, and 301), but this registry attribute is never referenced by any metric. The reusable registry therefore exposes incomplete per-metric attribute sets—for example, all context-level metrics appear attribute-less. Add `camel.context` to every context, route, processor, and thread-pool metric definition while retaining their existing attribute refs.
threads.hunk:
@@ -0,0 +1,555 @@
+# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/open-telemetry/weaver/v0.24.2/schemas/semconv.schema.json
+
+groups:
+  - id: attributes.camel
+    type: attribute_group
+    brief: Apache Camel attributes
+    attributes:
+      - id: camel.context
